name: Segmentio
description: Integrates Segment (analytics.js) so any analytics service can be added via a write key, with pluggable tracking data.
project_description:
Overview 

segmentio for Drupal is the easiest way to integrate segmentio analytics into your Drupal site.

 By installing segmentio's Drupal plugin you can add any analytics service to your site without touching any code.

 segmentio lets you send your analytics data to Google Analytics, Mixpanel, KISSmetrics, Chartbeat, and more... without having to integrate with each and every one, saving you time.

 Once you're setup, you can swap and add new analytics services with the click of a button!

 Features 

send your analytics data to segment.io, which internal submits your tracking data to Google Analytics, Mixpanel, KISSmetrics, Chartbeat, and more...

 Requirements 

It requires an account on Segment.io. You can create a test account on: https://segment.io/signup 

 

 Known problems 

* No option to limit tracking by page (or) user

 If you are interested in Contributing to this module, please submit patch in the issue queue
